definitions.gloss: powerful person; person in power; ruler
definitions.explanation: A person who holds political, social, or economic power. Used to describe leaders, politicians, or anyone wielding significant authority over others.

examples.japanese: {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|さか}らう→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to go against those in power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれて→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{消|き}えた→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: Throughout history, many rulers have risen and fallen.

examples.japanese: ⟦メディア→メディア：11165_media⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{監視|かんし}→監視：05521_kanshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}っている→担う：12787_ninau⟧。
examples.english: The media plays a role in monitoring the actions of those in power.

notes:
USAGE:
Often carries a slightly negative or critical nuance, implying someone who uses authority to control others. In news and political commentary, it frequently appears when discussing abuse of power or political dynamics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|さか}らう→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧ (to defy those in power)
- {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{横暴|おうぼう}→横暴：07988_oubou⟧ (tyranny of those in power)
- {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{媚|こ}びる→媚びる：09028_kobiru⟧ (to curry favor with the powerful)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支配者|しはいしゃ}→支配者：23113_shihaisha⟧: ruler — emphasizes control over territory or people
- ⟦{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}→実力者：21845_jitsuryokusha⟧: influential person — emphasizes actual ability and influence rather than formal authority
